answer: A fresh key arrives like a comet with no tail: zero sealed verdicts behind it. Weight accrues only from quorum-matched grading seals re-checked on-ledger against consensus, so no clone can whisper a borrowed reputation onto a sibling identity. A sybil swarm starts at a flat delta of nothing; each fake must grade its own way up across epochs, so the attacker's bill scales linearly with the identity count, never pooled or shared.
